fieldNotes.location: J.M. Smucker Uncrustables plant, 7351 Old Tuscaloosa Highway, JeffMet McCalla industrial park, Jefferson County AL. $1.1B, ~900,000 sq ft, opened Nov 2024 — the largest single-line bakery in the US, third Uncrustables plant. The roster pin was 5963m off (geocode flagged APPROXIMATE); resolved by web research (JeffMet McCalla park bordered by Old Tuscaloosa Hwy/US-11 NW, Norfolk Southern rail SE) and satellite — a single very large modern food-plant building with a complex roof, rooftop refrigeration banks (frozen-product plant), dock banks and a controlled gated entrance.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE — satellite (z20-z22) shows a divided entrance road at the building's SE corner with separate marked IN and OUT lanes (directional arrows), lane striping, and a barrier-arm gate structure spanning the lanes. Clear controlled truck checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE (inferred) — a small structure sits beside the gate lanes; a brand-new $1.1B food plant of this scale standardly runs a manned guard booth at the truck entrance. Not perfectly resolved in imagery — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ — extensive dock banks along the SW/west building face with ~22 trailers visible backed in or parked; a building of ~1,000,000 sq ft footprint of this type carries well over 50 doors. ~55 estimate; flagged low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 25-50 — a dedicated trailer-parking/drop lot adjacent to the SW dock apron; ~22 trailers visible, capacity ~70 across the apron + drop lot.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long, deep gate-to-dock approach with ample stacking room — 3+ truck queue capacity.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided entrance apron with separated in/out lanes and substantial unused paved width; clear room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved holding area inside the gate before the dock aprons.
fieldNotes.railServed: FALSE — Norfolk Southern rail borders the JeffMet park to the SE, but no rail spur runs into the Smucker plant property itself; the plant ships by truck.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — McCalla is an edge-of-metro small community; the plant sits in an industrial park surrounded by woodland and farmland off US-11, ~24 miles from Birmingham.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 1 — a single very large integrated manufacturing/distribution building.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 90.1 acres for the developed/fenced operational footprint (building + truck yards + drop lot + employee parking + retention). The full Smucker parcel is ~225 acres.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium — facility identified by location, scale and frozen-plant roof signature with high confidence, but the available satellite imagery appears to be from the construction/just-opened period and the gate/guard-booth details are partly inferred; no Street View reaches the gate itself.
